title: Accumulation with no reports: an always-accumulate service
summary: The block brings no work reports, but service 1729 is in the always-accumulate list $\chi_Z$ with 100000 gas. Its accumulation code runs anyway (the model executes the service's real PVM code), uses some of that gas, and the service's last-accumulation slot moves to the new timeslot.
params: the tiny chain the v0.8.0 vectors were made with ($\mathsf{E}$ = 12 slots per epoch, $\mathsf{Y}$ = 10, $\mathsf{C}$ = 2 cores, 6 validators)
notes: $N$ counts the work digests it accumulated (none here), $X$ the transfers it received, and $G$ the gas it used, out of the 100000 that $\chi_Z$ grants it. A service with statistics gets $a'_a = \tau'$.
name: accumulate-always
check: The model's posterior state, statistics and output root equal the vector's expected output (the comparison `acctest` makes). The accumulate suite as a whole is suspended until v0.8.1 vectors exist, because most of its services are v0.8.0 programs; this vector is one of those that pass.
